description: brig·id: the one Renovate preset, extended by every repository with
Renovate opens pull requests and never merges them.

schedule: before 7am on the first day of the month

description: A tag and its commit, written together and annotated on the line above:
The key may also be a variable whose name ends in REF: APP_REF: <40 hex> # v1.2.3.
Both are updated in one pull request: the commit is what is built, the tag says which release it is.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one pull request a week for all of them.
A major version is a decision: one pull request each, never grouped.

description: The project's own releases (crypto, core, app): proposed as soon as they exist, all in ONE pull
request per repository, whatever the kind of update. The core, crypto and the interface move
together, and two versions of the core in one build do not compile. Not brig-id/.github: its
reusable workflows are pinned by commit and go with the GitHub Actions.
A release of the project's own code changes what a server is made of, so release-please must
see it: a new minor (or major) comes in as a feat, anything else as a fix, and the server's next
release follows from it. Each type with its emoji, as the commit check wants.
